kind: Verified ideal ray geometry and angle screen analysis
scope: Ideal black floor and perfectly specular lossless walls. Absorptance mapped by reciprocity, without material or wavelength dependence.

definitions.weight: u=sin²θ, with trapezoidal quadrature in u of the azimuth mean. Final 89° value held constant through 90°.
definitions.hemisphere: P(90°)=integral from 0 to 1 of Abar(u) du.
definitions.contrast: Inside/outside. Values suppressed when outside emissivity is below 1e-6 to avoid ranking zero or nearly zero denominators.
definitions.balance_heuristic: εin × η. An explicitly exploratory criterion for illustrating a candidate, alongside cone strength and concentration extremes.
definitions.coarse_to_fine_comparison: Same geometry, denser angular grid and more rays, a combined numerical sensitivity check. This is not a confidence interval or physical-model accuracy estimate.
